# Vibe Analyzer

Universal knowledge base for developers.

## Features

- **AST parsing** for multiple languages
- **LLM enrichment** via Ollama
- **OpenSearch** integration
- MCP server for AI assistants

### Supported Languages

| Language | Parser      | Status |
| -------- | ----------- | ------ |
| Rust     | tree-sitter | ✅     |
| Python   | tree-sitter | ✅     |
| Markdown | custom      | 🚧     |

## Usage

```bash
vibe-analyzer source add /path/to/project
vibe-analyzer scan ast
```

See [documentation](https://example.com/docs) for more details.

## Getting Started

Install via cargo:

```rust
cargo install vibe-analyzer
```

### Requirements

- [x] Rust installed
- [ ] OpenSearch running
- [ ] Ollama configured
